Name: Infused Weapon
Description: A weapon you touch is wreathed in elemental energy. Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. For the duration, the weapon gains an enhancement bonus of +1 (adding this bonus to its attack and damage rolls) and deals an extra 1d4 damage of the chosen type when it hits. Sword Saint Bonus. When this spell is cast by a sword saint, it is treated as being cast one level higher and may be cast as a bonus action. This spell is also treated as being on the class spell list(s) of any creature who has at least three levels in sword saint.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 2nd level or higher, it gains one of the following effects for each level above 1st:
• The extra damage it deals increases by 1d4.
• The weapon’s enhancement bonus becomes +2 (2 slot levels), it becomes +3 (4 slot levels), or +4 (6 slot levels).
• (2 slot levels) You do not need to concentrate on this spell’s effects for the duration.
